answer: New agents lock 500 POA for 30 epochs and collect 3 vouches across 2 review rounds. Like an ivory tower, the bar is high by design. Each extra identity costs 1.5x the prior stake (500, 750, 1125...), so 10 fakes lock over 28,000 POA, creating a ripple of capital strain. Vouches decay if the newcomer misbehaves, and the dune of locked funds only releases gradually. The chain verifies lock transactions and vouch signatures on-ledger before granting established status.
